message: docs(live-edit-cost): put the handle bullet's record pointer at its end

edits.find: `if (handle.live) handle.write()` is correct on either side of that line. See ADR-056 and its amendment of 2026-09-04. The resolvers `track` and `motion` refuse an id the project never had, and `tryTrack` and `tryMotion` answer `undefined` instead, so an upsert is two lines with the branch at the call site rather than one verb whose cost depends on whether the node exists.
